properties.entry: SELECT id, template_name, number_of_placeholders, max_attempts, from_email, en_subject, ar_subject, en_body, ar_body, attachments_max_size, number_of_attachments, type_of_attachments, is_bulk FROM email_configurations WHERE template_name = :templateName
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM email_log WHERE template_id = :templateId AND invoker = :invoker AND date_time >= :dayStart AND date_time < :dayEnd
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM email_log WHERE template_id = :templateId AND invoker = :invoker AND date_time >= :dayStart AND date_time < :dayEnd AND to_email = :to

INSERT INTO email_log (template_id, to_email, cc_email, bcc_email, email_body, language, date_time, invoker, ip_address, attachments_meta_data) VALUES (:templateId, :to, :cc, :bcc, :emailBody, :language, :dateTime, :invoker, :ipAddress, :attachmentsMetaData)

SELECT SERIAL_NO, MESSAGE_BODY, MOBILE_NO, SEND_ATTEMPTS FROM INSIGHT.SMS_TABLE WHERE STATUS = :pendingStatus AND SERIAL_NO IN (SELECT SERIAL_NO FROM (SELECT SERIAL_NO FROM INSIGHT.SMS_TABLE WHERE STATUS = :pendingStatus ORDER BY PRIORITY, CREATION_DATE, SERIAL_NO) WHERE ROWNUM <= :batchSize) ORDER BY PRIORITY, CREATION_DATE, SERIAL_NO FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
UPDATE INSIGHT.SMS_TABLE SET STATUS = :inProgressStatus WHERE SERIAL_NO IN (:ids) AND STATUS = :pendingStatus
UPDATE INSIGHT.SMS_TABLE SET STATUS = :status, MESSAGE_ID = :messageId, SEND_DATE = :sendDate, SEND_ATTEMPTS = NVL(SEND_ATTEMPTS, 0) + 1 WHERE SERIAL_NO = :serialNo AND STATUS = :inProgressStatus
UPDATE INSIGHT.SMS_TABLE SET STATUS = :status, SEND_DATE = :sendDate WHERE SERIAL_NO = :serialNo AND STATUS = :inProgressStatus

SELECT message_id, service_name, expiry_in_seconds, token_length, sms_message_english, sms_message_arabic, max_attempts, sent_via, email_message_english, email_message_arabic, max_validation_attempts FROM otp_configuration WHERE service_name = :serviceName

SELECT message_id, service_name, expiry_in_seconds, token_length, sms_message_english, sms_message_arabic, max_attempts, sent_via, email_message_english, email_message_arabic, max_validation_attempts FROM otp_configuration ORDER BY service_name
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(attempts), 0) FROM otp_attempts WHERE service_name = :serviceName AND mobile_email IN (:recipients) AND last_attempt_date >= :dayStart
UPDATE otp_management SET active = '0' WHERE service_name = :serviceName AND mobile_email IN (:recipients) AND active = '1'

INSERT INTO otp_management (service_name, mobile_email, otp, creation_date_time, expiry_date_time, active, status, ip_address, validation_attempts) VALUES (:serviceName, :mobileEmail, :otp, :created, :expiry, '1', 'PENDING', :ipAddress, 0)
UPDATE otp_management SET status = 'SENT' WHERE id IN (:ids)
UPDATE otp_management SET status = 'FAILED', active = '0' WHERE id IN (:ids)
INSERT INTO otp_attempts (service_name, mobile_email, attempts, last_attempt_date) VALUES (:serviceName, :recipient, 0, :now) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
UPDATE otp_attempts SET attempts = CASE WHEN last_attempt_date < :dayStart THEN 1 ELSE attempts + 1 END, last_attempt_date = :now WHERE service_name = :serviceName AND mobile_email = :recipient

SELECT id, mobile_email, otp, validation_attempts FROM otp_management WHERE service_name = :serviceName AND mobile_email IN (:recipients) AND active = '1' AND expiry_date_time > :now ORDER BY id DESC FOR UPDATE
UPDATE otp_management SET active = '0', status = 'VALIDATED' WHERE id IN (:ids)
UPDATE otp_management SET validation_attempts = validation_attempts + 1 WHERE id IN (:ids)
UPDATE otp_attempts SET attempts = 0 WHERE service_name = :serviceName AND mobile_email IN (:recipients)
